name: opm-platform
description: Option Pricing Model (OPM) equity valuation platform

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && npx prisma migrate dev && npx prisma db seed && cd ../client && npm install
